name: chambers
title: Chambers
description: A high-street solicitor's theme drawn from the brief tied in pink tape: every service is the backsheet of a folded brief, a tall grey-blue panel with the matter in centred underlined capitals, the fee marked low, the firm's name at the foot and one band of tape across it, knotted once on the first-meeting panel.

tokens.--font-serif: every word on the site — an old-style serif
tokens.--text-small: size of the menu, brief titles and fees, headings in capitals, hours and tables
tokens.--text-tiny: size of the smallest print: the endorsement line and description on a brief, credentials, labels, the footer
tokens.--caps-track: letter spacing of a brief's title
tokens.--color-bg: the white bond paper of the page, and the gap between a brief and the sheet behind it
tokens.--color-text: typescript ink: all text, the double rules at the foot of each brief and of the footer, the rule over each person and under table headings
tokens.--color-muted: quieter ink: the endorsement line, clause letters, credentials, dates, labels, the registration line
tokens.--color-accent: the pink legal tape: the band across every brief and the first-meeting panel, the knot and its tails, the mark under the current menu entry
tokens.--color-tape-turn: darker pink where the tape turns round a sheet's edge, and the knot's crease
tokens.--color-paper: grey-blue draft paper: the briefs, the first-meeting panel, code
tokens.--color-paper-edge: the edges of the briefs and the first-meeting panel, the sheet behind them, the rules between office hours, the quote rule, the menu underline on hover
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules under the masthead, in tables and between news items
tokens.--measure: width of the column of running text
tokens.--brief-width: narrowest a brief may be on tablets and desktops
tokens.--brief-height: least height of a brief — tall and narrow, as a folded brief is
tokens.--tape: width of the band of tape
tokens.--tail: length of the knot's longer tail on a phone
tokens.--rule: weight of thin rules and sheet edges
tokens.--gutter: space kept at each side of the page on a phone
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and inside a brief
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks and rows of briefs
